desc_en: A single, coherent story following one Skopje resident along the Vardar quay: she photographs a minor car scratch, uploads it on a generic phone, receives approval, and gets the repaired car back at a small garage. One hero, one process, grounded North Macedonian realism, no signage or logos.
music: minimalist lo-fi corporate ambient track with light percussion, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Штетата ја пријавувате за минута, од телефон.
Сликајте го оштетувањето јасно, одблиску и оддалеку.
Прикачете и испратете — системот веднаш проверува.
Добивате одговор, па одите директно на сервис.

shots.kf: Late afternoon at the Vardar quay in Skopje, beside a parked compact silver car. Our hero, a woman in her early 30s with dark hair tied back, beige coat and black jeans, crouches by the rear bumper, studying a fresh scrape. Medium close-up, 35mm lens, soft overcast daylight, natural Balkan street textures, muted greys and warm skin tones, photorealistic, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She runs two fingers gently along the scrape to show depth while the camera makes a slow handheld push-in from medium to tighter framing, keeping her hands and damage in focus within five seconds.

shots.kf: Same location and wardrobe. Over-the-shoulder view of the hero holding a matte black, logo-free smartphone. The phone camera is aimed at the scraped bumper; her hands are clean and steady, fingers clearly visible. Tight close-up, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft daylight reflections on metal, restrained palette of silver, beige, and charcoal, photorealistic, no text or icons readable on screen.
shots.motion: She takes two deliberate photos—one close, one slightly wider—by shifting her wrists a few centimeters, while the camera performs a subtle right-to-left slide to reveal both the bumper edge and her phone in one continuous move.

shots.kf: Still at the Vardar quay, the hero now stands beside the car, shoulders relaxed, looking down at the same logo-free phone. The screen is visible only as an indistinct glow; no interface details readable. Medium shot, 35mm lens, natural overcast light, background softly blurred with riverside railing and stone paving, consistent beige and charcoal wardrobe tones, photorealistic, calm and credible, no signage anywhere.
shots.motion: She taps once to upload and then lowers the phone slightly as if waiting; the camera slowly tilts down from her face to her hands, ending on the phone glow within five seconds.

shots.kf: Interior of a small, unbranded local garage in Skopje, warm practical lighting. The same hero stands beside her silver car with the mechanic’s hands visible only from the elbows down, no face shown. The rear bumper is now clean and aligned. Medium-wide shot, 28mm lens, warm tungsten mixed with soft window light, palette of concrete grey, beige coat, and neutral metal tones, photorealistic, no readable labels or logos.
shots.motion: The mechanic gently wipes the repaired bumper with a microfiber cloth in one smooth pass while the camera makes a slow dolly left, revealing the bumper surface catching the warm light and looking uniform.

shots.kf: Back at the Vardar quay, same time-of-day feel, same wardrobe, same car position. The hero stands by the rear bumper, now spotless, and slips the matte black phone into her coat pocket. Medium shot, 35mm lens, soft overcast daylight, consistent muted palette, photorealistic. The frame holds clean space on the right for an end card overlay; no real-world text or signage visible anywhere.
shots.motion: She closes the car door with a gentle push and takes one confident step forward; the camera slowly pulls back on a stabilised gimbal, widening to show her and the now-perfect bumper in a single continuous five-second move.
